In detail

Blankenfelde/ Niederschönhausen is one of Berlin's 143 official Bezirksregionen, part of the Bezirk of Pankow. Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas records a Häufigkeitszahl (HZ) of 5,237 here — total recorded offences per 100,000 registered residents — with 1,573 cases recorded for the year, roughly 0.5× the citywide average, below it. HZ is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy shopping, transit or tourist area can show a higher HZ without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential zone can show a low HZ simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's only rating layer for Berlin so far — a real official police statistic, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data does not distinguish day from night, so both figures shown here are the same.

Wandroz currently rates Blankenfelde/ Niederschönhausen in Berlin, Germany as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Berlin, Germany, based on Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas (Häufigkeitszahl). Treat it as a general indicator, not a night-specific measurement.
